Default.Title: Default file manager
Default.Settings.Enabled: Use Navigator as the default file manager
Default.Settings.EnabledHintWindows: Folders and drives opened from the desktop and other apps, and Win+E, open in Navigator. Switching it off gives the role back to File Explorer.
Default.Settings.EnabledHintLinux: Folders opened from the desktop and other apps open in Navigator. Switching it off restores the previous file manager.
Default.Settings.DevelopmentBuild: Available when Navigator runs from its installed executable.
Default.Disabled: Folders open in the system's file manager again.
Default.NoXdgMime: xdg-mime (xdg-utils) is not installed, so the default file manager cannot be changed.
